name: Normal (stock physics)
note: Stock physics and no powers, but you still see other players' mods.

name: Gravity
note: Discs and players fall. Works with the server-side gate.

name: Super Speed
note: x2 thrusters, no speed cap, 4 boosts in a row.

name: Tiny (experimental)
note: You are 3x smaller in your own headset.

name: Blink (experimental)
note: A = invisible 5 s, X = blink where you look.

name: Spider-Man (experimental)
note: Hold X / A to web and swing.
